Operations & Service Delivery Manager

Stabilise Performance. Strengthen Compliance. Drive Sustainable Growth.

Your Story Community Supports is a growing NDIS provider delivering Supported Independent Living (SIL) and community participation services across Western Sydney.

We are seeking an experienced Operations & Service Delivery Manager to take full operational accountability across our service streams. This senior leadership role is responsible for operational performance, workforce management, compliance, financial sustainability and structured growth.

We need a strong operator—someone who builds effective systems, drives accountability and ensures services operate safely, efficiently and sustainably.

The Role

Reporting directly to the Director, you will oversee the performance and operation of all service delivery functions.

Key responsibilities include:

Operational leadership

- Oversee day-to-day service delivery across SIL and community supports.
- Lead Team Leaders, Coordinators and frontline teams.
-Manage workforce planning, rostering, staffing ratios and utilisation.
- Establish structured supervision and performance-management frameworks.
-Oversee incident management, safeguarding and risk mitigation.
-Ensure compliance with the NDIS Practice Standards and NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission requirements.
-Lead audit preparation and maintain ongoing regulatory readiness.

Financial and performance oversight

-Own operational KPIs and service-utilisation targets.
-Monitor staffing costs, budgets and financial sustainability.
-Maintain SIL occupancy and implement vacancy-management strategies.
-Establish clear operational reporting frameworks.
-Deliver monthly performance reports to the Director.

Systems and governance

-Strengthen internal processes and reduce operational risk.
-Establish clear responsibilities and accountability across teams.
-Improve documentation standards and compliance workflows.
-Ensure workforce practices align with the SCHADS Award.
-Coordinate recruitment planning according to operational demand.

Sustainable growth and sector engagement

-Strengthen referral pathways and participant intake processes.
-Develop professional relationships with Support Coordinators, allied health professionals and sector partners.
-Monitor referral activity, conversion rates and service commencement.
-Identify responsible expansion opportunities aligned with workforce and operational capacity.

About You

You are an experienced NDIS operational leader who understands both regulatory obligations and commercial performance. You are structured, analytical and comfortable being accountable for measurable outcomes.

You will bring:

-At least five years’ experience in disability services, including SIL.
-Demonstrated experience leading multi-site or multi-team operations.
-Strong knowledge of the NDIS Practice Standards and compliance frameworks.
-Proven experience managing workforce utilisation, staffing ratios and budgets.
-Confidence undertaking performance management and making operational decisions.
-Experience supporting complex participants and managing high-risk environments.
-Strong analytical, reporting and problem-solving skills.

-Current Working With Children Check.
-National Police Check.
-Current First Aid certificate.
-Full driver’s licence and access to a reliable vehicle.
-Full Australian working rights.

Desirable

-Relevant tertiary qualification in disability, social work, nursing, business or management.
-Experience overseeing multiple SIL homes.
-Strong knowledge of SCHADS Award obligations.
-Experience leading or preparing for NDIS audits.
-Experience implementing CRM, rostering or referral-tracking systems.

What We Offer

-Competitive salary reflecting the seniority and accountability of the position.
-Genuine decision-making authority within a senior leadership role.
-Direct access to executive leadership.
-The opportunity to strengthen systems and shape sustainable organisational growth.
-A clear pathway for progression as the organisation expands.
-A values-driven and participant-focused working environment.

Apply Now

If you are ready to take ownership of operational performance, strengthen compliance and build sustainable service-delivery systems, we invite you to apply.

Please submit your résumé and a cover letter outlining your NDIS operational leadership experience.

The Client  

Redhearts Support Services is a NDIS Registered provider located in Victoria. They provide individualised care and support to their participants with disabilities. 

As the demand for such disability care services grows in the region, they seek a passionate and qualified Disability Services Officer to join their team. 

 

 

 

The Role 

This is for a full-time basis with an annual salary set at $80,000 to $85,000 depending on experience plus superannuation. The role will be based at 634 Springvale Road, Mulgrave VIC 3170. 

 

 

Responsibilities  

Assess the unique needs of clients to tailor individualized care plans. 

Plan, develop, and implement educational, training, and support programs to address clients' needs. 

Conduct client interviews to comprehensively understand and assess the nature and extent of difficulties. 

Monitor and track the progress of clients, ensuring regular assessments and documentation. 

Facilitate referrals to external agencies and resources that can provide additional assistance and support. 

Evaluate community needs and available resources related to health, welfare, housing, employment, training, and other services for individuals with disabilities. 

Liaise with community groups, welfare agencies, government bodies, and private businesses to address community issues and promote awareness of available resources. 

Provide support to families and deliver education and care services for children and disabled individuals in various settings, including adult service units, group housing, and government institutions. 

Assist young people in resolving social, emotional, and financial problems related to their disabilities. 

Prepare submissions for funding and resources, outlining the specific needs and goals of the disability care services organization. 

Generate reports for government bodies and other agencies to provide updates on the organization's activities and outcomes. 

Advocate for the rights and needs of individuals with disabilities within the community and relevant institutions. 

Identify and refer residents to external agencies for additional support when necessary. 

  

 

 

 

Requirements 

In order to be shortlisted for this position, the right candidate needs to have: 

Must hold a minimum Cert IV in Disability and Diploma in Community Services 

Minimum 12 months’ experience supporting participants with complex disability needs, including psychosocial disability, intellectual disability, autism, acquired brain injury and physical impairment 

At least 12 months’ experience implementing positive behaviour support strategies, behaviour observation records, escalation plans and restrictive practice reporting requirements 

Minimum 12 months’ experience coordinating high intensity support needs, including manual handling, dysphagia support, medication prompting, seizure response, continence support and mealtime management 

At least 12 months’ experience preparing detailed case notes, shift reports, incident reports, progress summaries, risk reviews and participant outcome evidence for NDIS audits 

Willing to learn new skills and adapt your approach to meet the individual needs of the person you support. 

Effective prioritising, problem solving, time management and decision-making skills. 

Demonstrated ability to assist with daily programs and organising activities/excursions. 

Effective communication skills with clients, families, and healthcare professionals. 

Cultural sensitivity and respect for diverse backgrounds 

Have positive past employment work references

About us
We are a Brisbane-based leader in laboratory products and services. We hold NATA accreditation in Controlled Environments — testing and certifying biosafety cabinets, laminar flow units, fume cupboards, HEPA filters and cleanrooms for hospitals, universities, research institutes and government facilities across Queensland.

The role — and the deal
This is a hands-on, field-based job, and we train you from the ground up. You’ll travel to client sites around Brisbane (occasionally regional QLD) to test, certify, service and repair specialist lab equipment — biosafety cabinets, fume cupboards, centrifuges, incubators, ultra-low-temperature freezers, particle counters and more.

You don’t need to have done this before. If you’ve got a solid technical trade and the right attitude, we’ll teach you our NATA-accredited methods and put you through the certifications. You walk away building a portable, in-demand NATA qualification and a long-term career in a specialised field.

Who we’re after
A background in one of: electrical, instrumentation, HVAC / refrigeration, biomedical, or a related technical trade. More importantly, someone who:
•Follows through and gets the job done without being chased
•Works problems methodically and doesn’t give up when it’s fiddly
•Takes pride in doing things properly
•Can manage their own day and work unsupervised
•Deals with clients professionally

You’ll need
•A current driver’s licence
•Ability to obtain a Blue Card
•Willingness to have the vaccinations some lab sites require
•OK with occasional after-hours work and travel within QLD (paid as overtime)
•Basic computer skills (Simpro a bonus)
HVAC / refrigeration experience or a restricted / limited electrical licence is a real plus.

What we offer
•$70,000–$80,000 base + 12% super
•Overtime and call-out paid on top for after-hours and travel work
•Fully maintained company work vehicle (tools of trade; very limited personal use) and mobile phone
•We pay for your NATA certification and train you in our methods
•A genuine long-term career in a specialised, in-demand trade — not a stop-gap

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
How many years' experience do you have as a service technician?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as an Equipment Service Technician?
How many years' experience do you have in a Technical Support Role?
Do you have experience working in a NATA accredited laboratory?
Are you willing to undergo a pre-employment medical check?
Are you available to work split shifts?
Do you hold a current electrical licence?

result.description:
## ICT Customer Support Officer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Customer Support Officer to join our team and deliver high-quality technical assistance to end users across the organisation. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues, supporting the deployment and maintenance of computer infrastructure, and ensuring staff can make effective use of technology in their day-to-day work. You will bring strong communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. This position is well suited to a detail-oriented professional who thrives on problem-solving and is committed to delivering outstanding service.
## Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly and professionally to user queries regarding hardware and software problems, providing clear guidance and timely resolutions via phone, email, or in person
- Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues across a range of systems, applications, and devices, escalating complex matters to senior technical staff where appropriate
- Assess software and hardware requirements to develop practical solutions that meet user and business needs
- Install, configure, and update software applications and operating systems, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance across user environments
- Adapt and modify existing programmes and applications to align with evolving user requirements and organisational workflows
- Repair, replace, and maintain peripheral equipment including printers, terminals, modems, and other connected devices
- Assist in the implementation and maintenance of computer networks, contributing to the configuration and ongoing support of network infrastructure
- Support the design, maintenance, and updating of websites and internal digital platforms as required
- Promote and educate end users on the efficient and effective use of applications, equipment, and IT systems to maximise productivity
- Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and equipment inventory using ticketing and asset management systems
- Contribute to the development and documentation of IT support procedures, user guides, and knowledge base articles
- Provide support within a call centre environment where required, handling a high volume of inbound technical queries with professionalism and efficiency
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate IV or Diploma in Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
- Demonstrated experience in an ICT support, help desk, or technical services role
- Solid understanding of computer hardware, software applications, and operating systems (Windows and/or macOS)
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral equipment
- Familiarity with networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic network troubleshooting
- Proficiency in using IT ticketing and asset management systems to log, track, and resolve support requests
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues methodically and efficiently
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
- Customer-focused attitude with a professional, patient, and approachable manner
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and perform effectively under pressure
## Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified, or ITIL Foundation
- Experience supporting users in a call centre or high-volume help desk environment
- Knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and remote desktop support tools
- Familiarity with website content management systems (CMS) and basic web maintenance tasks
- Experience working within ITIL or other IT service management frameworks
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, certifications, and career development opportunities to advance your ICT career
- Enjoy flexibility in your working arrangements, with a consistent and structured shift schedule to support work-life balance
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly supports staff productivity and organisational success
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, recognising your skills and experience
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
